description: Implementation of BufferMtl class and related buffer management for Metal renderer in ANGLE project.

classes.name: ConversionBufferMtl
classes.description: Base class for buffer conversions, managing data initialization and size.

classes.name: IndexConversionBufferMtl
classes.description: Derived class for index buffer conversions, handling index type and offset.

classes.name: BufferMtl
classes.description: Main buffer class managing GPU buffer, shadow copy, and conversion buffers.

classes.name: BufferMtl::VertexConversionBuffer
classes.description: Handles vertex attribute buffer conversions with specific format, stride, and offset.

classes.name: SimpleWeakBufferHolderMtl
classes.description: Weak buffer holder class for Metal buffers.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets buffer data, re-allocates if size or usage changes.

methods.name: setSubData
methods.description: Updates a portion of the buffer data.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps the buffer for CPU access.

methods.name: mapRange
methods.description: Maps a range of the buffer for CPU access.

methods.name: unmap
methods.description: Unmaps the buffer after CPU access.

methods.name: getIndexRange
methods.description: Retrieves the index range from the buffer.

methods.name: getFirstLastIndices
methods.description: Retrieves the first and last indices from index data.

methods.name: getClientShadowCopyData
methods.description: Returns pointer to shadow copy data for buffer update.

methods.name: getVertexConversionBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a vertex conversion buffer with specific format, stride, and offset.

methods.name: getIndexConversionBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an index conversion buffer with specific type and offset.

methods.name: markConversionBuffersDirty
methods.description: Marks all conversion buffers as dirty for re-conversion.

methods.name: setSubDataImpl
methods.description: Internal method to update shadow copy and mark buffers dirty.

methods.name: commitShadowCopy
methods.description: Uploads shadow copy to GPU buffer.
